steps.note: Keyboard focus traversal (quadraui#918): Tab cycles focus across the two panes of a TabGroupController via FocusGroup::cycle, which wraps at the last index back to the first (see compose/focus_group.rs's cycle_forward_wraps unit test) — the same primitive AppShell's own activity-bar cursor deliberately does NOT use (that one saturates at the ends, per compose/app_shell.rs). This scenario proves the wrapping variant end to end through a real AppLogic, not just the primitive in isolation. The fixture starts with pane 0 already focused (TabGroupDemo::new calls focus_pane(0)).
A second Tab wraps back to pane 0 rather than saturating or going out of range — the wrap, not just the cycle, is what this scenario is for.
